## 02. PERMANOVA

::: callout-note
To test the effects of Mangrove type and Mangrove system on the Bray-Curtis dissimilarity, a PERMANOVA analysis was conducted using adonis2.
:::


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Extract and transpose OTU table
otu_mat <- t(otu_table(ps))

# PERMANOVA with adonis2
set.seed(123)
adonis_result <- adonis2(
  otu_mat ~ Mangrove_system + Depths * Mangrove_type,
  data = sample_data,
  method = "bray",
  permutations = 999,
  strata = metadata$ID,
  by = "terms")

# show adonis result
print(adonis_result)
```

### Extract p-values


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Define abbrevs
location_abbrevs <- c(
  "San Pedro River" = "SPR",
  "Fossil Lagoon" = "FL",
  "Impaired Términos Lagoon" = "ITL")

# Extract values
locations <- unique(metadata$Mangrove_system)
p_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(locations), ncol = length(locations),
                   dimnames = list(locations, locations))
r2_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(locations), ncol = length(locations),
                    dimnames = list(locations, locations))

for (comp in names(pairwise_adonis)[-1]) {  # Exclude 'parent_call'
  pair <- strsplit(comp, "_vs_")[[1]]
  loc1 <- pair[1]
  loc2 <- pair[2]
  p_matrix[loc1, loc2] <- pairwise_adonis[[comp]]$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  p_matrix[loc2, loc1] <- pairwise_adonis[[comp]]$`Pr(>F)`[1]  # Simetric
  r2_matrix[loc1, loc2] <- pairwise_adonis[[comp]]$R2[1]
  r2_matrix[loc2, loc1] <- pairwise_adonis[[comp]]$R2[1]  # Sim
}
diag(p_matrix) <- 1  # p-value = 1 
diag(r2_matrix) <- 0  # R² = 0 

# abbrevs in matrix
abbrev_locations <- location_abbrevs[locations]
names(abbrev_locations) <- NULL
dimnames(p_matrix) <- list(abbrev_locations, abbrev_locations)
dimnames(r2_matrix) <- list(abbrev_locations, abbrev_locations)

# Convert to long format
p_melt <- melt(p_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
colnames(p_melt) <- c("Location1", "Location2", "p_value")
r2_melt <- melt(r2_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
colnames(r2_melt) <- c("Location1", "Location2", "R2")
```
:::


### Heatmap of adonis posthoc


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Heatmap of p-values
heatmap_plot_p <- ggplot(p_melt, aes(x = Location1, y = Location2, fill = p_value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "gray40") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "white", mid = "white", high = "gray40",
                       midpoint = 0.025, limits = c(0, 1),
                       name = "p-value") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", p_value)), color = "black", size = 3) +

        plot.title = element_text(size = 12))

# Heatmap de R²

# join cowplot
```

## 04. Beta disper

::: callout-note
To validate the dissimilarity of the data, and to determine whether the differences found are due to changes in composition or to variations in dispersion within groups, the homogeneity of the dispersions between Mangrove type and Mangrove system was calculated using betadisper. Subsequently, the significance of the differences in dispersion was calculated with permutest
:::


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# library(vegan)
# library(phyloseq)
# Bray distance matrix
dist_matrix <- phyloseq::distance(ps, method = "bray")
```
:::


### By Mangrove system


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# betadisper
disp_location <- betadisper(dist_matrix, sample_data$Mangrove_system)
anova_beta_disp <- anova(disp_location)

# Show dispersion by group
disp_location$group.distances
```

## 06. Core-level analysis — Reviewer 2, point 4

::: callout-note
`Mangrove_system` es constante dentro de un core, por lo que no puede probarse con `strata = ID` (permutar dentro del core nunca mueve la etiqueta de sistema). Se colapsa cada core a UN perfil (peso igual Surface/Mid/Deep) y se usa el core como unidad independiente. La profundidad conserva su test a nivel de muestra con `strata = ID` (sección 02), que sí es válido.
:::

### 06.1 — colapso a un perfil por core (cubre: *qué cores no tienen las 3 categorías* + *n de cores por grupo*)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# tabla de features: muestras x taxa, counts crudos (misma repr. que secciones 01-02)
otu_sxt <- as(t(otu_table(ps, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)), "matrix")
md <- data.frame(sample_data(ps)); md$CoreID <- as.character(md$ID)

# --- cores sin alguna categoría S/M/D (para Mirna) ---
cat_tab <- table(md$CoreID, md$Depths)
missing_cat <- apply(cat_tab, 1, function(r) paste(colnames(cat_tab)[r == 0], collapse = ", "))
missing_cat <- missing_cat[missing_cat != ""]
cat("Cores sin alguna categoría de profundidad:\n"); print(missing_cat)
```

```

```


```{.r .cell-code}
# --- colapso en dos pasos (peso igual S/M/D) ---
agg_mean <- function(mat, grp){ s <- rowsum(mat, grp); s / as.vector(table(grp)[rownames(s)]) }
cat_mean  <- agg_mean(otu_sxt, paste(md$CoreID, md$Depths, sep = "__"))  # paso 1: core x categoría
core_of   <- sub("__.*$", "", rownames(cat_mean))
core_prof <- agg_mean(cat_mean, core_of)                                  # paso 2: 1 perfil por core

core_md <- md[!duplicated(md$CoreID), ]; rownames(core_md) <- core_md$CoreID
core_md <- core_md[rownames(core_prof), ]
cat("\nn de cores por Mangrove_system:\n"); print(table(core_md$Mangrove_system))
```

#### 06.4 — tabla suplementaria core-level


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(123)
pdisp <- permutest(disp_core, permutations = 9999)$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1]
tableS8_core <- as.data.frame(adonis_core_system) %>%
  mutate(Factor = rownames(.), Level = "core-level") %>%
  dplyr::select(Level, Factor, Df, SumOfSqs, R2, F.Model = F, p_value = `Pr(>F)`) %>%
  filter(!Factor %in% c("Total","Residual")) %>%
  mutate(Dispersion_p = ifelse(Factor == "Mangrove_system", pdisp, NA),
         across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4)))
tableS8_core
```
